dataset: PhysioNet Apnea-ECG 1.0.0 learning set (real recordings only)
ci_method: percentile bootstrap over recordings, 2000 resamples, seed 0
limitations: Domain shift: this model was trained on clinical ECG recordings from the PhysioNet Apnea-ECG learning set (a small number of people in a sleep lab), and it is applied to wrist-wearable nightly summaries. Accuracy on WHOOP data is not claimed and has not been measured. The task validated here is separating apnea-group recordings from control-group recordings, not finding apnea in the general public. Borderline recordings were excluded. The sample is small, so the confidence interval is wide. WakeSafe is a screening aid, not a diagnosis.
